# exo_email_tenant_settings (Resource)

Manages the EmailTenantSettings configuration via Set-EmailTenantSettings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `enable_priority_account_protection` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnablePriorityAccountProtection parameter.
- `ignore_dehydrated_flag` (Boolean) Maps to the -IgnoreDehydratedFlag parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
